approvers: None, I decide alone, but the glazing subcontractor would have to agree
reason: The glazing subcontractor is responsible for damage until handover, not me, so why would I pay extra to protect their windows? On my small jobs a cheap film and a bit of care does the job, and I would not add a new budget line and supplier for it.
objection: It is not my cost or my risk. At about 19 euro per m2 plus a 150 m2 minimum and a 50% deposit, it eats margin on a small job for something the glazier already covers.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape from the hardware store, and leave damage to glazing to the glazing subcontractor under our contract.
would_change_my_mind: If a client or developer specifically asked for it and paid for it as a separate line on the quote, I would listen.
